name: @activepieces/piece-mollie
description: Automate Mollie payments, orders, refunds, customers, and invoices. Triggers on payment events and statuses.

auth.description: Enter your Mollie API key (starts with live_ or test_)

create_order.name: create_order
create_order.description:
⚠️ We no longer recommend using the Orders API. Please refer to the Payments API instead.

Create a new order in Mollie

orderNumber.description: The order number for this order. We recommend each order number to be unique.

currency.description: A three-character ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD)

lines.description: The order lines for the order

name.description: A description of the line item

unitPriceCurrency.description: Currency for unit price (should match order currency)

unitPriceValue.description: The price of a single item including VAT (e.g. "10.00")

totalAmountCurrency.description: Currency for total amount (should match order currency)

totalAmountValue.description: The total amount of the line including VAT and discounts

vatRate.description: The VAT rate applied to the line (e.g. "21.00" for 21%)

vatAmountValue.description: The amount of value-added tax on the line

sku.description: The SKU, EAN, ISBN or UPC of the product sold

discountAmountValue.description: Any line-specific discounts, as a positive amount

imageUrl.description: A link pointing to an image of the product sold

productUrl.description: A link pointing to the product page in your web shop

billingTitle.description: The title of the person (e.g. Mr., Mrs.)

billingGivenName.description: The given name (first name) of the person

billingFamilyName.description: The family name (surname) of the person

billingCountry.description: A country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

includeShippingAddress.description: Whether to include a separate shipping address

shippingTitle.description: The title of the person (e.g. Mr., Mrs.)

shippingGivenName.description: The given name (first name) of the person

shippingFamilyName.description: The family name (surname) of the person

shippingCountry.description: A country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format

locale.description: The language to be used in the hosted payment pages

redirectUrl.description: The URL your customer will be redirected to after the payment process

cancelUrl.description: The URL your customer will be redirected to when they cancel the payment

webhookUrl.description: The webhook URL where order status updates will be sent

shopperCountryMustMatchBillingCountry.displayName: Shopper Country Must Match Billing Country
shopperCountryMustMatchBillingCountry.description: Restrict payment methods to those from the billing country only

expiresAt.description: The date the order should expire in YYYY-MM-DD format

consumerDateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the consumer in YYYY-MM-DD format

testmode.description: Whether to create the order in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new order in Mollie via the legacy Orders API, with required order lines and a billing address. Use only when an integration specifically needs the deprecated Orders API; for new payment flows prefer Create Payment or Create Payment Link instead. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate order even with an identical order number.

create_payment_link.name: create_payment_link
create_payment_link.description: Generate a new payment link targeting a customer, product, or specific amount

description.description: A short description of the payment link (max 255 characters)

includeAmount.description: Whether to include a fixed amount or let customer enter amount

currency.description: A three-character ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD)

includeMinimumAmount.description: Whether to set a minimum amount (only when no fixed amount)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect customer after payment completion

includeLines.description: Whether to include detailed order line items

lines.description: Order line items (required for certain payment methods)

description.description: A description of the line item

quantityUnit.description: The unit for the quantity (e.g. pcs, kg, cm)

unitPriceValue.description: The price of a single item including VAT

totalAmountValue.description: The total amount including VAT and discounts

vatAmountValue.description: The amount of VAT on the line

sku.description: The SKU, EAN, ISBN or UPC of the product

includeBillingAddress.description: Whether to include billing address details

includeShippingAddress.description: Whether to include shipping address details

reusable.description: Allow multiple payments using the same link

auth.description: Enter your Mollie API key (starts with live_ or test_)

allowedMethods.description: Payment methods allowed for this link (empty = all enabled methods)

customerId.description: Customer ID (only relevant for first sequence type)

testmode.description: Whether to create the payment link in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Creates a shareable Mollie payment link a customer can open to pay. Can carry a fixed amount, an open/minimum amount the customer fills in, and can be one-off or reusable for multiple payments. Choose this for sending a checkout URL (invoice, donation, manual collection) rather than driving a redirect-based checkout in code. Not idempotent: each call creates a new link.

create_payment.name: create_payment
create_payment.description: Creates a new payment in Mollie

currency.description: A three-character ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect customer after payment completion

cancelUrl.description: URL to redirect customer when they cancel payment

includeLines.description: Whether to include detailed order line items

lines.description: Order line items (required for certain payment methods)

description.description: A description of the line item

quantityUnit.description: The unit for the quantity (e.g. pcs, kg, cm)

unitPriceValue.description: The price of a single item including VAT

totalAmountValue.description: The total amount including VAT and discounts

vatAmountValue.description: The amount of VAT on the line

sku.description: The SKU, EAN, ISBN or UPC of the product

includeBillingAddress.description: Whether to include billing address details

includeShippingAddress.description: Whether to include shipping address details

locale.description: The language to be used in the hosted payment pages

restrictPaymentMethodsToCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to restrict payment methods

captureDelay.description: Delay before automatic capture (e.g. "8 hours", "2 days")

testmode.description: Whether to create the payment in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Creates a payment in Mollie and returns a hosted checkout URL the customer is redirected to; a redirect URL is required. Supports one-off, first (to set up a mandate), and recurring sequences — recurring requires a customer ID and mandate. This is the recommended way to collect a payment. Not idempotent: each call creates a new payment.

create_customer.name: create_customer
create_customer.description: Creates a new customer in Mollie

name.description: The full name of the customer

email.description: The email address of the customer

locale.description: The language to be used in the hosted payment pages

metadata.description: Additional data to save alongside the customer (JSON string)

testmode.description: Whether to create the customer in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Creates a customer record in Mollie (optional name, email, locale, and metadata) to associate with payments and mandates for recurring billing. Use before setting up recurring or first-sequence payments that need a customer ID. Not idempotent: each call creates a new customer, with no deduplication on email.

auth.description: Enter your Mollie API key (starts with live_ or test_)

description.description: The description of the refund (max 255 characters)

currency.description: A three-character ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD)

metadata.description: Additional data to save alongside the refund (JSON string)

includeExternalReference.description: Whether to include external reference details

externalReferenceId.description: Unique reference from the payment provider

reverseRouting.description: Pull back funds routed to connected merchants (full refund only)

includeRoutingReversals.description: Specify detailed routing reversals for partial refunds

routingReversals.description: Detailed routing reversals for connected merchants

sourceType.description: Type of source to pull funds from

organizationId.description: ID of the connected organization to pull funds from

testmode.description: Whether to create the refund in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Refunds an existing Mollie payment, fully or partially, by specifying the refund amount and currency against a target payment ID. Use to return funds for a charged payment. Not idempotent: each call issues another refund against the payment, so repeating it can over-refund.

search_order.name: search_order
search_order.description:
⚠️ We no longer recommend using the Orders API. Please refer to the Payments API instead.

Searches for orders in Mollie

from.description: Start the result set from this order ID onwards

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return (1-250, default: 50)

profileId.description: Profile ID to retrieve orders for (optional)

testmode.description: Whether to search in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Lists orders from the legacy Mollie Orders API, paginated with an optional cursor (from order ID), limit, sort direction, and profile filter. Use only when working with the deprecated Orders API; prefer Search Payment for current payment flows. Idempotent: read-only listing with no side effects.

search_payment.name: search_payment
search_payment.description: Retrieve all payments created with the current website profile

from.description: Start the result set from this payment ID onwards

limit.description: Maximum number of payments to return (1-250, default: 50)

profileId.description: Profile ID to retrieve payments for (optional)

testmode.description: Whether to search in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Lists payments for the connected Mollie profile, paginated with an optional cursor (from payment ID), limit, sort direction, and profile filter. Use to look up existing payments or page through payment history. Idempotent: read-only listing with no side effects.

search_customer.name: search_customer
search_customer.description: Retrieve a list of all customers

from.description: Start the result set from this customer ID onwards

limit.description: Maximum number of customers to return (1-250, default: 50)

testmode.description: Whether to search in test mode

aiMetadata.description: Lists customers in the connected Mollie account, paginated with an optional cursor (from customer ID), limit, and sort direction. Use to look up existing customers or page through the customer list. Idempotent: read-only listing with no side effects.

new_customer.name: new_customer
new_customer.description: Fires when a new customer is created in Mollie

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new customer is created in the connected Mollie account. Polls the customer list and emits each newly created customer, representing a contact that can be used for payments and recurring mandates.

new_order.name: new_order
new_order.description: Fires when a new order is created in Mollie

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new order is created in Mollie via the legacy Orders API. Polls the order list and emits each newly created order. Relevant only for the deprecated Orders API; for current payment flows use the New Payment trigger.

new_settlement.name: new_settlement
new_settlement.description: Fires upon a new settlement event (e.g. payout)

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new settlement appears in Mollie, representing a payout of accumulated payments (minus fees, refunds, and chargebacks) to the merchant bank account. Polls the settlement list and emits each new settlement. Use for reconciliation and payout-driven accounting.

new_invoice.name: new_invoice
new_invoice.description: Fires when a new invoice is generated

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Mollie generates a new sales invoice (via the sales-invoice.created webhook), representing a billing document issued to the merchant for Mollie fees and charges. Use to automate invoice handling or bookkeeping.

new_payment.name: new_payment
new_payment.description: Fires when a new payment is created/received

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new payment appears in the connected Mollie profile. Polls the payment list and emits each newly created payment regardless of status (open, paid, failed, etc.), so it signals payment creation rather than confirmed settlement.

new_refund.name: new_refund
new_refund.description: Fires when a payment refund is created

auth.description: Enter your Mollie API key (starts with live_ or test_)

paymentId.description: The payment to monitor for refunds

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new refund is created on a specific Mollie payment, representing funds returned to the customer. Requires selecting the payment to monitor; polls that payment's refunds and emits each new one.

new_chargeback.name: new_chargeback
new_chargeback.description: Fires upon a payment chargeback event

auth.description: Enter your Mollie API key (starts with live_ or test_)

paymentId.description: The payment to monitor for chargebacks

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a chargeback is filed against a specific Mollie payment, representing a customer-disputed transaction reversed by their bank or card issuer. Requires selecting the payment to monitor; polls that payment's chargebacks and emits each new one.
